definitions: To stop the breath of (someone) by squeezing or obstructing the windpipe.
To have difficulty breathing because something is blocking your throat.
To fill (a space) so as to make movement difficult or impossible.
To fail to perform effectively at a critical moment due to nervousness.
examples: I choked on a piece of bread.
The drains were choked with leaves.
The team choked in the final minutes of the game.
